mission.Tezctlan_Xiomara_Infiltration1.a: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. This is a good deal: a rock that is useless to us in exchange for something that actually works.
mission.Tezctlan_Xiomara_Infiltration1.b:
Several groups of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% have already infiltrated %STATION_NAME%. You need to find them and eliminate them before they take over the igvalite. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is ready to give out a really good reward for this rock.

How did we even get into this, Boss?
mission.Tezctlan_Xiomara_Infiltration1.d: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate all groups of quasimorphs who came for the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>.

Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has held %STATION_NAME% for a long time. However, it is now under attack from %VICTIM_NAME%.

We have recognized the signature of an Igvalite coming from the station. It is a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It seems that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is using this place to store energy.

We can eliminate the groups of quasimorphs of %VICTIM_NAME% who have come for igvalite. Let's do this, and the reward from the new owners of the Solar System will be extremely high.
mission.Tezctlan_Xiomara_Infiltration1.o: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate all groups of quasimorphs who came for the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>.
Servants of <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> are settling in at %STATION_NAME%. Soon <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> will become the master of the Solar System. He transferred something extremely valuable to Magnum.

We don't know how some quasimorphs remain in our reality, while the majority are always attracted by their bramfaturas. I want to say that %STATION_NAME% is simply teeming with warriors of %VICTIM_NAME%. Sensors show that they are aware of the attack and are waiting for your arrival.

Proceed methodically, do not take unnecessary risks. Kill enough and the survivors will run. Upon completion of the mission, as soon as you leave the facility, Tezctlan will send his duke.

Details: Enemies of Tezctlan, which are much more dangerous than people, have appeared in the Solar System. Those who do not understand that the time of the Red and Gold Empire of the Sun has passed. Only one empire has a future: the Emerald Empire.

%STATION_NAME% is in the hands of the rebel %VICTIM_NAME%. These upstarts must be expelled from physical reality forever, which will become an inexhaustible source of gavvakh only for Tezctlan, the true master of the Solar System.
mission.Tezctlan_Xiomara_Sabotage1.after: The quasimorphs of %VICTIM_NAME% at %STATION_NAME% resemble bees in a disturbed hive. The time will soon come to strike again here. <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> is extremely pleased with our work. We received one of Gannix's artifacts as a gift from the Master.
mission.Tezctlan_Xiomara_Sabotage1.brief: What the sensors are showing is impossible to believe. These <color=#FFFEC1>reliquaries</color>... they are literally shining! %STATION_NAME% is swarming with quasimorphs. Show the %VICTIM_NAME% faction how humans fight. Let us prove our usefulness to <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color>.
mission.Tezctlan_Xiomara_Sabotage1.detai:
Details: Tezctlan has partially lifted the veil of mystery surrounding why the quasimorphs of the Bramfatura of Venus are able to remain in physical reality for extended periods of time.

In the past, the King of Gannix learned how to bind his energy to a physical object of worship — a reliquary. Somehow, the quasimorphic faction %VICTIM_NAME% stole this secret from the Master. At %STATION_NAME%, there are reliquaries that grant them the ability to linger in our world.

We will give pleasure to Tezctlan if we destroy these quasimorphic artifacts.
mission.Tezctlan_Xiomara_Sabotage1.objec: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquaries</color> — quasimorphic artifacts resembling statues or obelisks.
mission.Tezctlan.names: Tonal;Nagual;Tonal and Nagual;Gift of Xolotl;Yohualtecuhtin;God of Venus;Scarlet Letter;Arena of Mortals;Master of Fates;Tensegrity;Puzzle of Bodies;Thicker than Blood;Twice Born;Kingdom of Fear;King and Assassin;Smoking Mirror;Fifth Sun;Flayed God;Heart of Darkness;Jaguar's Heart
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Defense1.after: %STATION_NAME% is a symbol that the order of the Solar System has changed forever. %VICTIM_NAME% failed to show that humanity is capable of challenging the new masters. We received a valuable artifact from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% in gratitude for our work.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Defense1.briefi: <color=#FFFEC1>The Civil Resistance</color> colnodes have already penetrated the perimeter of %STATION_NAME%. We'll drop you off in the main strike zone. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold your defense</color> until the enemies retreat.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Defense1.detail: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %STATION_NAME% is evidence that the appearance of the Solar System has changed forever. But not all people are ready to accept that the awakening of quasimorphs directly affects their fate. The owner of the station, %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, wants us to <color=#FFFEC1>take up its defense</color> from the forces of %VICTIM_NAME%. The outcasts need a bright event, an example to corporations that they, too, are able to influence the balance of power in the System. Let's show them how wrong they are.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Elimination1.af:
Xiomara is pleased with our work. %VICTIM_NAME% is in turmoil; additional forces have been deployed to %STATION_NAME%. Maybe it's time to hit them in another place?

Xiomara gave us a worthy reward, the artifact is already on Magnum.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Elimination1.br: The shuttle will land wherever it can. %VICTIM_NAME% is using countermeasures on %STATION_NAME%, so we have to maneuver. Sensors show that personnel occupy positions according to the combat schedule. Carry out a massacre, but get to the <color=#FFFEC1>commander</color> of these psychos. Let's make <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> happy!
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Elimination1.de:
Details: Feathered Masks are gradually joining the fight for the Solar System. They perceive people as allies or a source of gavvakh. And it would be better for us to be the first.

Now Xiomara is interested in %STATION_NAME%, which is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. Feathered Masks believe that there is a factor preventing the capture of this place. They talk about "a great warrior defending a place of power." Our analysts studied the station and came to the conclusion that we are talking about the commander of the station’s defense.

Xiomara will be extremely pleased if we eliminate this warrior.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Escort1.after: The envoys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% conveyed to us the praise of the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> and called for the expansion of allied relations. If we work for the future winner now, we will take a worthy place in the future new hierarchy of the Solar System.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Escort1.briefin: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has called us for a specific <color=#FFFEC1>task</color>: to escort the Duke to safety at %STATION_NAME%. You should easily deal with the militants of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Escort1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% has launched activities around %STATION_NAME%. However, the object is in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. The rightful owners of the Solar System will not give up so easily. And %VICTIM_NAME% understands this. It seems that it is preparing an action to eliminate the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

The quasimorphs call on their faithful servants to fulfill their sacred duty. If we want to strengthen our relationship with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, we must take on the role of the Duke's personal guard. We need to escort it to the safe location at the station and protect it from attacks by the colnodes of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Escort1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Infiltration1.a: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. This is a good deal: a rock that is useless to us in exchange for something that actually works.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Infiltration1.b:
Several infiltration teams from %VICTIM_NAME% have already infiltrated %STATION_NAME%. You need to find them and eliminate them before they take over the igvalite. The quasimorphs are ready to give out a really good reward for this rock.

I hope we chose the right side, Boss.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Infiltration1.d:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% conducts operations related to %STATION_NAME%. The object has long been in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

We have recognized the signature of an igvalite emanating from the station. It is a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It seems that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is using this place to store energy.

We can get here before the attackers and eliminate the infiltration teams of %VICTIM_NAME%. If we do this, the future owners of the Solar System will be extremely generous.
<color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> is pleased with our work. %STATION_NAME% now resembles Pandemonium. A gift from her appeared in Magnum's cargo hold. It's worth testing this artifact in action.

Even if the personnel of %STATION_NAME% are expecting an attack by <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color>, the appearance of a trained operator <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color> here will be a surprise to them. Act according to the situation, be careful.

Details: Xiomara has seriously taken up the task of establishing order in the Solar System. Now she is looking for anyone who will help the Feather Masks capture %STATION_NAME% to continue the fight against Tezctlan.

%VICTIM_NAME% holding on to this metal piece of material as if it were the greatest of treasures. Let's crush them, and Xiomara will have a task worthy of our talents.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Ritual1.after: Good job, <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> extremely pleased. The ritual was completed successfully. <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color> will be able to operate in this part of the Solar System and beyond. They transferred the reward to Magnum.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Ritual1.briefin: <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> cannot wait, the ritual must be completed at any cost. %STATION_NAME% is under the control of %VICTIM_NAME%, and it will not retreat without a fight. Make your way to the ritual site and <color=#FFFEC1>hold your position</color> until it is completed. Let's make <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> happy!
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Ritual1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Ritual1.details:
Details: Xiomara has mastered the secret that allows her and Feathered Masks to maintain contact with physical reality. But this requires constant effort. An influx of gavvakh, reliquaries, and regular rituals that extract energy from the bramfaturas of the planets are needed.

The Lady senses that on %STATION_NAME% the influence of the bramfatura has reached its peak. It's time for the ritual. However, %VICTIM_NAME%, which controls the station, stands in the way.

Xiomara calls on all available forces to ensure that the Duke has the opportunity to perform the sacred ceremony. We have to hold the defense until the ritual is completed.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Ritual1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Sabotage1.after:
Without a server, %VICTIM_NAME% has no chance of holding %STATION_NAME%. Somehow, the quasimorphs gradually learn about the sensitive infrastructure of people.

Xiomara is pleased with our work. She transferred something special from her arsenal to Magnum.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Sabotage1.brief: We will try to drop you as close as possible to the nearest <color=#FFFEC1>computer</color>. It will not be easy: sensors indicate that the station’s defenders are already preparing for an attack. The good news is that the locations of the computers on %STATION_NAME% are clearly visible, and I have marked them on your map. Have they chosen the role of public enemies? Show them the consequences of that decision.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Sabotage1.detai:
Details: Feathered Masks are gradually joining the fight for the Solar System. We have more and more opportunities to serve the Mistress. She shows interest in %STATION_NAME%.

%VICTIM_NAME% placed there what the quasimorphs called an Altar of Knowledge. The Feathered Masks need this device destroyed before they go to capture %STATION_NAME%. Apparently, we are talking about some kind of computer, which %VICTIM_NAME% uses for an unknown purpose. If we destroy it, Xiomara will be favorable to us.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Security1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% retains full control of %STATION_NAME%. Our quasimorphic allies (or masters?) thanked us and sent valuable cargo to Magnum.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Security1.brief: The %VICTIM_NAME% group has dispatched special squads to %STATION_NAME% to locate and seize critical equipment and data. You must <color=#FFFEC1>prevent these squads from leaving the station</color>. Xiomara herself will consider it a failure if even one such squad escapes.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Security1.detai:
Boss, %VICTIM_NAME% is attacking %STATION_NAME%, regardless of losses. Looks like the outcasts really need something at this station. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% calls on its loyal servants to help. The quasimorphs would like to keep the station for themselves.

If we respond to the call for help, we will need to provide the attackers with a worthy meeting: hold back their attacks until reinforcements from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will arrive.
mission.Xiomara_CivilRes_Security1.objec: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Prevent the colnode squads from escaping %STATION_NAME%. I will mark them on your map.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Control1.after: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. The cargo has been received. <color=#FFFEC1>Creepy</color> creatures, but I think I'm starting to get used to them.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Control1.briefing: Mercenaries from %VICTIM_NAME% are already attacking %STATION_NAME%. You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color>. Eliminate the attackers before they destroy the artifact.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has long held %STATION_NAME%. Presumably, the station is built into some kind of system that allows quasimorphs to stay in physical reality. %VICTIM_NAME% found out about this and decided to attack. Its target is the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquary</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be grateful to us if we protect it.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Control1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color> - a quasimorphic artifact similar to a statue or obelisk.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Defense1.after: %STATION_NAME% was and remains a symbol that the order of the Solar System has changed forever. The <color=#FFFEC1>Hexarchy</color> will not be able to hide the truth forever. Lying will not help them when %BENEFICIARY_NAME% strikes back. A valuable gift from her arrived on Magnum, which will greatly help us in the future.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Defense1.briefing: The attackers have already penetrated the perimeter of %STATION_NAME%. We have not yet understood whether it is <color=#FFFEC1>Security Service</color> or <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color>. But it shouldn't make much difference to you. We'll drop you off in the main strike zone. As soon as you find your feet, <color=#FFFEC1>take up defensive position</color>. Sooner or later the attackers will retreat, you just need to hold out for enough time.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Defense1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% firmly holds %STATION_NAME%. This bastion of theirs in physical reality is evidence that the Solar System is returning under the control of its ancient masters. However, people have not yet understood which side to take.

%BENEFICIARY_NAME% wants us to defend %STATION_NAME% from the attack of %VICTIM_NAME%. It needs a bright event to advertise in the SBN. Of course, the corporation will not say that it seized the asset from the quasimorphs, it will lie about the Civil Resistance. Our task: to make sure that it won't get what it wants.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Elimination1.after:
Xiomara is pleased with our work. %VICTIM_NAME% is in turmoil; additional forces have been deployed to %STATION_NAME%. Maybe it's time to hit it somewhere else?

Feathered Masks gave us a worthy reward, the artifact has already been delivered to Magnum.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Elimination1.briefi: The shuttle will land wherever it can. %STATION_NAME% security team is using countermeasures, so we have to maneuver. Sensors show that personnel occupy positions according to the combat schedule. Make a massacre, but <color=#FFFEC1>eliminate the target</color>. We will prove to <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> that we are worthy of serving.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Elimination1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and eliminate the security officer of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Elimination1.detail:
Details: Feathered Masks were forced to join the fight for the Solar System. The fact that the Hexarchy hides the existence of quasimorphs plays into our hands. Xiomara and her rebel order can slowly move through the System.

Now the lady's gaze is directed towards %STATION_NAME%. Feathered Masks say that there is a factor there that prevents the capture of this place. They report an energetic and courageous warrior fighting on the side of the people. Our analysts studied the personnel of %VICTIM_NAME% and came to the conclusion that she is talking about an employee of the local security service.

Xiomara will be extremely pleased if we kill this great warrior.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Elimination1.object: Request of <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color>: eliminate the security officer of %VICTIM_NAME%. Their location is marked on your map.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Escort1.after: The envoys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% conveyed to us the praise of the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> and called for the expansion of allied relations. If we work for the future winner now, we will take a worthy place in the future new hierarchy of the Solar System.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Escort1.briefing: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has called us for a specific purpose: <color=#FFFEC1>escort the Duke to safety</color> at %STATION_NAME%. Corporations send their best fighters into battle against quasimorphs, so save your strength.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Escort1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% has launched activities around %STATION_NAME%. However, the station is in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. The rightful owners of the Solar System will not give up so easily. And %VICTIM_NAME% understands this. It seems that it is preparing an action to eliminate the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

The quasimorphs call on their faithful servants to fulfill their sacred duty. If we want to strengthen our relationship with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, we must take on the role of the Duke's personal guard. We need to escort it to the safe location on the station and protect it from attacks by fighters of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Xiomara_Corp_Escort1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.

We can get here before the attackers and eliminate the infiltration teams of %VICTIM_NAME%. If we do this, the future owners of the Solar System will be extremely generous.
